_comment: release-check.sh probes, run on every `after` (and by `release-check.sh <env> probes`). Fields: name, path, envs (default all), status (default 200), json (body must parse), headers {name: value, or null = only present}, absent_headers [..], contains (substring), enabled (default true). Requests carry User-Agent bifrost-release-check/1, so a probe of a deprecated route (TD-40 caller log) is recognisable as ours. Per-release probes go in expected.d/<date>-<name>.probes.json and are passed with --probes.
